description: This file defines the ChannelsPage class for end-to-end testing of the Mattermost application's channel UI using Playwright. It includes methods for interacting with various UI components such as modals, menus, and posts within a channel.

classes.name: ChannelsPage
classes.description: A class representing the channels page in the Mattermost UI for testing purposes, providing methods to interact with channel elements, modals, menus, and posts.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Waits for the main channel view to be visible.

methods.name: toNotContainText
methods.description: Verifies that the page does not contain the specified text.

methods.name: getLastPost
methods.description: Retrieves the last post in the channel.

methods.name: getInvitePeopleModal
methods.description: Initializes and returns the InvitePeopleModal for inviting users to a team.

methods.name: getMembersInvitedModal
methods.description: Initializes and returns the MembersInvitedModal after users are invited.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to a specific team and channel URL.

methods.name: gotoMessage
methods.description: Navigates directly to a message thread within a team.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Posts a message in the current channel.

methods.name: replyToLastPost
methods.description: Replies to the last post in the channel and verifies the reply.

methods.name: openTeamSettings
methods.description: Opens the team settings modal.

methods.name: openChannelSettings
methods.description: Opens the channel settings modal.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the general settings modal.

methods.name: openNewChannelModal
methods.description: Opens the modal to create a new channel.

methods.name: openCreateTeamForm
methods.description: Opens the form to create a new team.

methods.name: newChannel
methods.description: Creates a new channel with specified name and type.

methods.name: openUserAccountMenu
methods.description: Opens the user account menu.

methods.name: openProfileModal
methods.description: Opens the user profile modal.

methods.name: openProfilePopover
methods.description: Opens the profile popover for a specific post.

methods.name: scheduleMessage
methods.description: Schedules a message to be sent after a specified delay.

methods.name: scheduleMessageFromThread
methods.description: Schedules a message within a thread.
